versions.subject: New Rules: transformed elastic to sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_net:
    - Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    - OriginalFilename: 'net.exe'
selection_net1:
    - Image|endswith: '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFilename: 'net1.exe'
selection_parent:
    ParentName: '\net.exe'
selection_view:
    CommandLine|contains: 'view'
selection_time:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'time'
        - '\\\\*'
condition: (selection_net or (selection_net1 and not selection_parent)) and (selection_view or selection_time)
versions.spl: Image="*\\net.exe" OR OriginalFilename="net.exe" OR (Image="*\\net1.exe" OR OriginalFilename="net1.exe" NOT ParentName="\\net.exe") CommandLine="*view*" OR (CommandLine="*time*" CommandLine="*\\\\*")
